response.overview: Sanatan, a young man in love, receives a seven-day ultimatum from Kamadeva to share his first kiss with Indrani. Since Indrani insists on marriage before intimacy, Sanatan decides to marry her. Finding a suitable home, however, becomes a hilarious challenge as every new house brings unexpected obstacles. With Kamadeva disguised as a broker, their attempts at a wedding night are repeatedly disrupted. As the deadline approaches, Sanatan must discover the right moment to fulfil his destiny. Finally, during an unexpected journey, Sanatan and Indrani share their long-awaited kiss, bringing their romantic quest to a joyful end.
response.title: Phoolsajya
